review.summary: The 14725-triangle cabinet retains the reference silhouette, visible empty-rack texture, keypad strip, retrieval recess, seams and feet. Finished front/side/back PBR remains close to the accepted high-detail source without new broad red-panel dents. Fresh FBX and GLB checks pass.

issues.problem: Neutral-only surface faceting and small rim softening after reduction; finished material remains stable.

review.summary: All views and full-resolution hero inspected. Red cabinet, dark empty vending racks/coils, keypad/payment strip and lower retrieval opening are recognizable and separated. No large unwanted labels or material leakage appear on the sides/back.

issues.problem: Coil rows are approximate painted surface detail with some uneven repetition and a different row layout than the reference; they are not separate internal shelf meshes.
Paler, glossier red under the review lighting.

review.summary: Cabinet proportions, front window frame, keypad/payment column, lower retrieval recess, door seams and small feet are retained. The window interior is represented as a shallow closed surface, so the next material stage must show the reference empty rack/coil appearance. Back and side panels have no major invented structures.

issues.problem: Internal racks are shallow surface detail rather than independently open shelf geometry; verify appearance after texturing.
Small seam pits along the back edges.
